# unifi_official_firewall_policy (Resource)

Manages a firewall policy (zone-based firewall rule) via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication. The `source`, `destination`, `ip_protocol_scope` and `schedule` attributes are JSON-encoded strings matching the Official-API object shapes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires a controller running 10.1.78+ with API-key authentication (Official API).

# The source, destination, ip_protocol_scope and schedule attributes are
# JSON-encoded strings matching the Official-API object shapes.
resource "unifi_official_firewall_policy" "allow_iot_to_wan" {
  name   = "allow-iot-to-wan"
  action = "ALLOW"

  source = jsonencode({
    zoneId = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  })
  destination = jsonencode({
    zoneId = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
  })
  ip_protocol_scope = jsonencode({
    ipVersion = "BOTH"
    type      = "ALL"
  })
}

# A logging BLOCK policy that only matches new/invalid connections.
resource "unifi_official_firewall_policy" "block_invalid" {
  name                    = "block-invalid"
  action                  = "BLOCK"
  logging_enabled         = true
  description             = "Drop new and invalid connections."
  connection_state_filter = ["NEW", "INVALID"]

  source = jsonencode({
    zoneId = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  })
  destination = jsonencode({
    zoneId = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
  })
  ip_protocol_scope = jsonencode({
    ipVersion = "BOTH"
    type      = "ALL"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Action applied to matched traffic. One of `ALLOW`, `BLOCK`, `REJECT`.
- `destination` (String) JSON-encoded firewall policy destination object (must include at least `zoneId`).
- `ip_protocol_scope` (String) JSON-encoded IP protocol scope object (must include at least `ipVersion`).
- `name` (String) Name of the firewall policy.
- `source` (String) JSON-encoded firewall policy source object (must include at least `zoneId`).

### Optional

- `connection_state_filter` (List of String) Match on firewall connection state. Any of `NEW`, `INVALID`, `ESTABLISHED`, `RELATED`. If unset, matches all connection states.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the firewall policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the firewall policy is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `ipsec_filter` (String) Match on traffic encrypted, or not encrypted by IPsec. One of `MATCH_ENCRYPTED`, `MATCH_NOT_ENCRYPTED`. If unset, matches all traffic.
- `logging_enabled` (Boolean) Generate syslog entries when traffic is matched. Defaults to `false`.
- `schedule` (String) JSON-encoded firewall schedule object. If unset, the policy is always active.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
- `index` (Number) The evaluation index of the policy, assigned by the controller.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using the site name and the firewall policy UUID: <site>:<id>
terraform import unifi_official_firewall_policy.allow_iot_to_wan default:66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666
```
